must_contain: A care context is the unit a provider links to a patient's ABHA address, carrying a reference number and a display name and nothing clinical.
Create one care context per outpatient visit (OPD) and one care context per inpatient admission (IPD).
The display name must not include any sensitive or confidential information such as test results or diagnoses.
notes: Group B, a bare topic noun phrase: it catches a definition that treats a care context as a record or a document rather than the two-field grouping unit of M2.
